headline: Revenue doubles but profit misses on currency effects
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 773.1B (about +100% y/y) and operating profit KRW 160.6B (about +69% y/y, margin 20.8%); EPS was KRW 2,943, up 47.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 2,943 fell 20.7% q/q and rose 47.6% y/y. Reports put revenue at KRW 773.1B and operating profit at KRW 160.6B, with operating profit down 15.7% q/q and margin below last year's 24.6%. One source says won appreciation cut operating profit by about KRW 27.8B. Results missed forecasts by about 11%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from StockHub and Korea Herald summaries. Sources give inconsistent full-year guidance, so none is recorded. EPS is Yahoo data.
